T: All that jazz. All that food.
D: Two murderesses in 1920s Chicago compete for fame with the help of a slick lawyer.
P: Serve the drinks when Velma takes the stage at the nightclub.
S: Prunes stuffed with blue cheese, wrapped in bacon and baked crisp
Prunes stuffed with blue cheese, wrapped in streaky bacon and baked crisp, a Jazz Age party classic.
Chicago-style hot dog bites, all the way
the city of Chicago in the jazz age

Mini franks in poppy seed rolls with yellow mustard, bright green relish, onion, tomato, pickle spears, sport peppers and a dash of celery salt. Simmer 12 cocktail frankfurts in water for 5 minutes. Brush 12 small soft rolls with melted butter and sprinkle with poppy seeds, then warm in the oven for 3 minutes. Fill each with a frank, a line of yellow mustard, sweet green relish, finely diced white onion, a tomato wedge, a thin pickle spear and a few pickled chillies, then finish with a pinch of celery salt.
Twisted puff pastry strips with parmesan and paprika
Puff pastry brushed with egg, covered in grated parmesan and paprika, cut into thin strips like cell bars, twisted, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
M: Rare roast beef shaved thin and dunked in garlicky oregano jus, piled into crusty rolls with hot giardiniera and roasted sweet capsicum. Rub a 1.2kg beef topside with oil, salt, pepper and oregano and roast at 220C for 15 minutes, then 180C to 52C inside. Rest, chill and slice paper thin. Simmer 750ml beef stock with 4 garlic cloves, 1 tsp oregano, chilli flakes and the roasting juices for 10 minutes. Slice and roast 2 red capsicums. Dunk the beef in the jus and pile into 4 crusty rolls with capsicum and hot giardiniera, spooning over extra jus.
Chicago deep dish with mozzarella, Italian sausage and garlicky crushed tomato
Buttery dough pressed into a deep tin, mozzarella first, then Italian sausage, then chunky tomato sauce, parmesan on top, baked at 220C for 35 minutes.
W: Sparkling wine jelly set in coupes over raspberries
Gelatine bloomed and dissolved in warm sugar syrup, cold sparkling wine stirred in gently, poured into coupes with raspberries, set 4 hours so the bubbles stay trapped.
K: Gin, lemon and sugar syrup shaken and topped with soda over ice
45ml gin, 25ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup shaken hard with ice, strained into a tall glass and topped with soda water.

Cut the eggplant into 24 strips, brush with the oil, paprika, maple syrup and salt and cook in a hot pan until soft.
Wrap each prune in a strip of eggplant and secure with a toothpick.
Bake until the edges are crisp.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Press the dough mixed with the butter into a deep greased tin.
Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the crushed garlic.

Layer the mozzarella, then the mushroom crumble, then the tomato.
Finish with the parmesan and bake at 220C.

s.note: Prunes stuffed with blue cheese, wrapped in bacon and baked crisp
s.how: Stuff 24 pitted prunes with a small piece of blue cheese, 100g in total. Wrap each in half a rasher of streaky bacon, using 12 rashers, and secure with a toothpick. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the bacon is crisp.

s.note: Twisted puff pastry strips with parmesan and paprika
s.how: Brush a sheet of puff pastry with beaten egg and cover with grated parmesan and a pinch of paprika. Cut into thin strips like cell bars, twist each a few times and lay on a lined tray. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes until puffed and golden.

m.note: Chicago deep dish with mozzarella, Italian sausage and garlicky crushed tomato
m.how: Press pizza dough mixed with melted butter into a deep greased tin. Layer sliced mozzarella first, then crumbled Italian sausage, then crushed tomatoes simmered with garlic. Finish with grated parmesan and bake at 220C for 35 minutes. Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

w.note: Sparkling wine jelly set in coupes over raspberries
w.how: Soak 5 gelatine leaves in cold water. Warm 150ml water with 100g sugar, then squeeze the gelatine and stir in to dissolve. Cool slightly, then gently stir in 500ml cold sparkling wine. Pour into coupes over a few raspberries and chill for 4 hours.

d.note: Gin, lemon and sugar syrup shaken and topped with soda over ice
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml gin, 25ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup hard with ice. Strain into a tall glass over fresh ice and top with cold soda water. Make the syrup ahead by dissolving equal parts sugar and hot water, then cooling.
